title: Protocol Playbook — Edison Science Upstream Contract
description: Defines how to map a LOW_FIDELITY stoplight alert from the Crusher Labs Observation Engine to multi-variable parameter overrides and cost-accounting ledger deductions. Each protocol is a Standing Operating Procedure (SOP) that the orchestrator evaluates autonomously at every epoch. Protocols MUST NOT contain hardcoded epoch schedules — all activation is trigger-driven.

protocols.description: Array of Standing Operating Procedures. Each maps a diagnostic stoplight trigger to physics modifiers and cost deductions.

protocol_id.description: Unique protocol identifier (e.g., 'SOP-001'). The Reactive Protocol Engine tracks activation/deactivation by this ID.

description.description: Detailed description of what this SOP does and when it should fire.

trigger.description: Defines which LOW_FIDELITY stoplight alert activates this SOP. The protocol engine evaluates this condition against the observation engine's per-instrument stoplight output at each epoch.

modifiers.description: Physics and behavior parameter overrides applied while this SOP is active. Multiple active SOPs have their modifiers merged (most restrictive wins for scalars, union for zone closures).

costs_per_epoch.description: Resource costs deducted from the ledger EVERY epoch this SOP remains active.

activation_costs.description: One-time resource costs deducted from the ledger when this SOP is first activated.

category.description: Cost category for FINANCIAL_AUDIT reporting. 'intervention' = operational response. 'surveillance' = increased monitoring.

TriggerCondition.description: Maps a LOW_FIDELITY stoplight signal from a specific instrument class to an activation threshold. The protocol engine checks: 'Does instrument X show stoplight_level Y or worse in at least min_zones_affected zones?'

instrument_class.description: The observation engine instrument class name that generates the stoplight signal. Must match one of the registered instrument names.

stoplight_level.description: Minimum stoplight level that triggers activation. GREEN = no trigger (protocol never activates). AMBER = elevated anomaly. RED = critical hazard.

min_zones_affected.description: Minimum number of zones/agents showing this stoplight level for the trigger to fire.

min_agents_affected.description: Alternative to min_zones_affected for patient-level instruments (clinical_rdt, clinical_qpcr, clinical_microbiology).

min_modes_affected.description: For detection_escalation: minimum integrated detection modes at the required stoplight level.

PhysicsModifiers.description: Parameter overrides injected into the simulation engine while the SOP is active. All scalar overrides MUST be in [0.0, 1.0]. The transmission core reads these scalars at the start of each epoch.

hvac_filter_type_label.description: Human-readable label for the HVAC filter type (e.g., 'HEPA', 'MERV-16').

surface_decontamination_factor.description: Fraction of surface fomite mass removed per epoch by sanitization teams.

direct_contact_scalar.description: Multiplier on Pathway 1 (direct contact) dose. 1.0=no change, 0.0=fully blocked.

hvac_airborne_scalar.description: Multiplier on Pathway 3 (long-range HVAC airborne) dose.

diagnostic_cadence_multiplier.description: Multiplier on diagnostic testing frequency. 2.0 = double testing rate.

close_zones.description: Zone IDs to close while this SOP is active. MUST exist in spatial_layout.json. Closed zones have occupancy reduced to zone_occupancy_cap.

zone_occupancy_cap.description: Maximum number of agents allowed in closed zones (default: 2 for essential personnel only).

CostBlock.description: Resource consumption definition. The cost ledger deducts these amounts from the simulation's budget, material inventory, and labor capacity.

materials.description: Material item consumption. Keys must match items defined in resource_costs.json material_inventory. Values are integer counts consumed.
